اعتليتن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَلَيْتُنَّ (iʕtalaytunna) /iʕ.ta.laj.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
# اُعْتُلِيتُنَّ (uʕtulītunna) /uʕ.tu.liː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
